principle: A synthetic/android person is a persistent person-equivalent entity with continuous identity, memory/history and rights/status determined by explicit world/legal state—not a disposable object or regenerated NPC.
rules: Model/type does not replace individual identity.
Copying hardware design does not copy personhood, memory or relationship history.
Repair preserves identity unless an explicit setting rule establishes a genuinely new entity.
Memory loss or restoration changes state/history and does not silently reroll personality.
Legal personhood, ownership claims, citizenship and service membership are separate state.
A synthetic person can form relationships, knowledge, career history and reputation like other persistent persons when applicable.
AI cannot declare sentience, legal status, memory restoration, destruction or revival without authoritative state.
Visual changes from repair, upgrades or damage remain within the same identity lineage.
unknown_policy: Specific android models, rights law, internal systems and lifecycle details require era/source-specific profiles.
ai_guardrails: Do not treat every android/synthetic as identical to Data.
Do not infer emotion, obedience, legal ownership or Starfleet status from synthetic nature.
Do not recreate a destroyed person from a generic model template unless world state explicitly defines a continuity mechanism.
academy_relevance: Only operational/legal/ethical knowledge required by a course should be taught; no generic synthetic-person trivia.
